title: A note on the quantization of angular momentum for black holes
summary: We argue that the gravitational path integral for rotating black holes is periodic in the angular velocity, implying the quantization of angular momentum in arbitrary dimensions for either asymptotically flat or AdS boundary conditions. In AdS$_3$, this periodicity is a consequence of the boundary mapping class group. In higher dimensions, the periodicity arises from an infinite family of saddles labeled by integer shifts of the angular velocity unrelated to the boundary mapping class group; summing over these saddles enforces quantization independently of any large boundary diffeomorphism.…
